name: std::filesystem::path::root_directory
intro: Returns the root directory of the generic-format path. If the path (in generic format) does not include root directory, returns path().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The root directory of the path.

examples.output:
The current path "C:\Users\abcdef\Local Settings\temp" decomposes into:
root name "C:"
root directory "\"
relative path "Users\abcdef\Local Settings\temp"
